title: 第一卷 第1章 你是霍放的女人？
content_zh:
童喻下了场刚要进休息室，还没反应过来对方就将她推到墙角，微凉的手指贴在她的腰间。

    薄薄的布料隔不开他手掌的温度，贴上来的那一刹那如电流般划过她的身体。

    “你想干什么？”童喻很冷静，她不信他敢动她。

    霍放那双勾人夺魂的眼睛在童喻脸上轻扫，贴在她腰间的手掌轻轻磨擦着，嘴角上扬，挑衅的意味很明显。

    童喻腰间走火，她没见过这么放肆的男人。

    “听说你是霍放的女人？”

    霍放的动作越来越大胆，从她的腰间滑到她圆翘紧致的臀上。

    笑意越来越深。

    童喻被他逼近墙角，根本无处可逃。

    这会儿休息室没人来，她也喊不来人。

    “你知道还这么对我，你不怕他弄死你？”童喻厉声警告男人。

    霍二少名声在外，性情不定，谁要惹了他，往后的日子都不会好过。

    别人暗地里称他疯二少。

    霍放挑眉，兴趣盎然，他的目光落在女人的胸口，大手按住她的臀，用力往上压了一下，她的身体向他贴紧。

    童喻面红耳赤，心跳加速。

    他居然不怕霍二少！

    来场子里玩的男人都知道她是霍二少的女人，只敢看，不敢动。

    哪怕那只手都伸到眼前，近在咫尺，也只能悻悻放下。

    “弄死我？呵，连人都不认识，你也敢招摇撞骗？嗯？”他靠近她的耳边，气息灼烧的她的肌肤。

    霍放的目光定格在她锁骨处的纹身上，那是一个开了花的“放”字，设计很美，也很显眼。

    看到她披着狼皮在他面前狐假虎威，霍放真是觉得有趣。

    这么多年，第一次有人敢借他的名头混社会，真是胆大包天。

    童喻懵了。

    他识破她了！

    他是认识霍放吗？
content_en:
When Tong Yu came off the stage and was about to enter the lounge, before she could react, the other party pushed her to the corner and put his cold fingers on her waist.

    The thin fabric couldn't isolate the warmth of his palm, and the moment he pressed it against her, it shot through her body like an electric current.

    "What do you want to do?" Tong Yu was very calm. She didn't believe he dared to touch her.

    Huo Fang's seductive eyes glanced at Tong Yu's face, his palms attached to her waist rubbed gently, and the corners of his mouth raised, his provocation was obvious.

    Tong Yu's waist caught fire. She had never seen such a presumptuous man.

    "I heard that you are Huo Fang's woman?"

    Huo Fang's movements became more and more bold, sliding from her waist to her round and tight buttocks.

    The smile grew deeper and deeper.

    Tong Yu was cornered by him and had nowhere to escape.

    No one came to the lounge at the moment, and she couldn't call anyone.

    "You know you still treat me like this, aren't you afraid that he will kill you?" Tong Yu warned the man sternly.

    Second Young Master Huo has a good reputation and an unstable temperament. Anyone who offends him will not have an easy life in the future.

    Others secretly called him the Crazy Second Young Master.

    Huo Fang raised his eyebrows with interest. His eyes fell on the woman's chest. He pressed her buttocks with his big hands and pressed her upwards hard. Her body pressed against him.

    Tong Yu's face turned red and his heartbeat quickened.

    He is not afraid of Mr. Huo!

    The men who came to play all knew that she was Mr. Huo's woman, and they only dared to look at her but not to move.

    Even if that hand is stretched out in front of my eyes, close at hand, I can only put it down in frustration.

    "Kill me? Ha, you don't even know anyone, how dare you lie? Huh?" He came close to her ear, his breath burning her skin.

    Huo Fang's eyes were fixed on the tattoo on her collarbone. It was a flowered word "Fang". The design was beautiful and very conspicuous.

    Huo Fang found it really interesting to see her wearing wolf's clothing and acting like a tiger in front of him.

    For the first time in so many years, someone dared to use his name to get involved in society. It was really audacious.

    Tong Yu was stunned.

    He saw through her!

    Does he know Huo Fang?
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 1 Are you Huo Fang’s woman?
